name: Throne's Gift
shortDescription: You accepted the gift. The music grows louder as you travel the vacuum - persistent, insistent. Interfaces respond like instruments, each command a note only you can hear.
longDescription: Gain the ability to automate any vessel. Unlock more points to automate ships with as you gain experience.

name: Hellspawn
shortDescription: Born to no record, in a place erased from maps. The vision came early. It hasn’t left. You’ll claim what’s owed, whatever the price. Come, step off the cliff - it's a long way down.
longDescription: Gain unnatural abilities as you descend into darkness.
